origin.says: Simplified from 顯: 日 (sun), 絲 (silk threads) and 頁 (head): looking at fine threads in sunlight, made visible, to show. The simplified form keeps 日 and a shortened form of the threads, which looks like 业 (trade); 頁 was dropped.

ety.hint: A tongue 立 forming a sound in the mouth 日

origin.says: Made from 言 (speech) with an extra stroke inside the mouth, marking sound or voice as against words. The top and the marked mouth later turned into 立 (stand) over 日 (sun), which are only shapes here.

节.def: festival; knot, joint; segment; to economize, to save

ety.hint: Simplified form of 節; sections of bamboo ⺮

origin.says: Simplified from 節: ⺮ (bamboo) for the meaning plus 即 as the sound, the joint of a bamboo stem. ⺮ became 艹 (grass) and 即 was cut to its right half.

节.name: festival

超.def: to jump over, to leap over; to overtake, to surpass

origin.says: 走 (to run) for the meaning plus 召 (to summon) as the sound: to run and leap over, to overtake, to surpass.

超.name: overtake

医.def: to cure, to heal, to treat; doctor; medicine

origin.says: Replaces 醫 (殹 as the sound plus 酉 wine jar, since wine was used as medicine). 医 itself was an old character: 矢 (arrow) in 匸 (a case), a quiver, taken over for its sound.

医.name: doctor

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 安 (peace) as the sound: a wooden table or desk; papers on the desk became 'case, file'.

创.def: to establish, to create; cut, wound, trauma

origin.says: Simplified from 創: 倉 (granary) as the sound, now 仓, plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: a cut, a wound; later to begin, to create.

创.name: wound

origin.says: 心 (heart) for the meaning with a sound part on top: one's bearing, attitude. The traditional 態 had 能 (able) as the sound; the simplified form replaced it with 太 (too).
First written 申 (lightning) alone, since lightning seemed divine; 礻 (altar, spirit) was added for the meaning, 申 staying as the sound: god, spirit.

ety.hint: A hand 又 doing tricks with a spear 戈

origin.says: Simplified from 戲: 戈 (halberd) for the meaning plus 䖒 as the sound, first an army's flank, later play and drama. The simplified form replaces 䖒 with the stand-in 又 (hand).

易.def: to change; to exchange, to trade; simple, easy

origin.says: Early forms show a vessel with liquid pouring over, related to 益 (increase) and the original form of 賜 (bestow). It was borrowed for 'change' and 'easy'. The modern 日 (sun) + 勿 (do not) shape is accidental; it is not a lizard.

易.name: easy

流.def: to flow, to drift, to circulate; class

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 㐬 as the sound: water that flows. 㐬 shows a baby born head first with fluid streaming out, so one reading takes it as a meaning part too.

流.name: flow

origin.says: Simplified from 雖: 虫 (creature) with 唯 as the sound, a lizard-like animal, borrowed for 'although'. The simplified form drops the 隹 (bird) of the sound part.

模.def: model, pattern, standard; to copy, to imitate

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 莫 (do not) as the sound: a wooden mould, so a model or pattern.

模.name: mould

版.def: printing block, edition; register; volume, version

origin.says: 片 (slab of wood) for the meaning plus 反 (reverse) as the sound: a wooden board, then a printing block, an edition.

版.name: edition

origin.says: Simplified from 習. The oracle-bone form shows 羽 (feathers, wings) over 日 (sun), read as a young bird repeatedly trying its wings; another reading takes the lower part as the sound. The simplified form keeps a single half of 羽.

习.name: practice
习.in: 翻翰翼耀谬煽扇翘塌羽翔翅翁蹋戳翩嗡寥翠

委.def: to appoint, to commission, to send

origin.says: One reading: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 禾 (grain) as the sound, first meaning bent and yielding, then to entrust; another source calls the origin unclear.

委.name: entrust

origin.says: Simplified from 義: 羊 (sheep, here 'good, auspicious') for the meaning plus 我 (I) as the sound. The simplified form replaced all of it with a simple shape like 乂 (cut) plus a dot.

断.def: to sever, to cut off, to interrupt

ety.hint: Using an axe 斤 to harvest grain 米

origin.says: Simplified from 斷: silk threads cut off with 斤 (axe). The simplified form replaces the tangle of threads on the left with 米 (rice) inside a corner stroke.

断.name: sever

origin.says: Origin unclear; possibly taken from the left half of 別 (separate), which has a related meaning, now written like 口 (mouth) over 力 (strength).

ety.hint: Gold 钅 that once was 昔 but is lost

origin.says: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 昔 (former times) as the sound: a grindstone, then criss-cross, mixed up, wrong. Simplified from 錯.

转.def: to move, to convey; to turn, to revolve, to circle; to forward mail

origin.says: Simplified from 轉: 車 (cart) for the meaning plus 專 (a hand turning a spindle) as the sound: turning like a wheel. Both parts take their simplified shapes 车 and 专.

转.name: turn around

采.def: to collect, to gather; to pick, to pluck

ety.hint: A hand picking 爫 fruit from a tree 木

origin.says: 爫 (hand from above) over 木 (tree): a hand picking from a tree, to pluck and gather. It also took over 採 (pick, with 扌 hand).

采.name: pluck

环.def: bracelet, ring; to surround, to loop

origin.says: Simplified from 環: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus a sound part 睘, replaced by 不 (not), a folk form adopted officially: a jade ring; hence ring, loop, to surround.

环.name: jade ring

继.def: to continue, to carry on; to succeed, to inherit

origin.says: From 繼 (continue): 糸 (silk) plus a part showing strands of silk tied end to end (a sound part too), threads joined to carry on. The simplified form takes 纟 (silk) and shortens the right side to 米 (rice) inside a corner stroke.

继.name: continue thread

足.def: foot; to attain, to satisfy; enough

ety.hint: The leg 口 above the foot

origin.says: A drawing of a leg with the foot below: the top 口 (here a kneecap or leg, not a mouth) over 龰 (foot). 'Standing on your own feet' led to 'enough'.

足.name: foot

origin.says: From 嚴: many mouths 吅 (shouting) with 敢 (dare) as the sound, first 'boastful words'; the sense shifted to 'stern, strict'. The simplified form keeps only the top outline of the old character.

属.def: class, category, type; family; affiliated, belonging to

origin.says: Simplified from 屬: 尾 (tail) for the meaning plus 蜀 (silkworm) as the sound, things joined like a tail to a body: to belong to. The simplification cut 尾 down to 尸 and swapped 蜀 for 禹 (Yu).

属.name: belong

存.def: to exist; to survive, to maintain; to keep, to store; to deposit

origin.says: 子 (child) for the meaning plus 才 (talent) as the sound: to keep alive, to exist, later to store. The 才 is squeezed into the top-left corner around the 子.

存.name: store away

origin.says: Oracle forms draw two strings of cowrie shells, a unit of money, hence 'pair', then 'friend, companion'. The two parts now look like 月 (moon) but are not moons.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 聲; see that character for the etymology

origin.says: Simplified from 聲: 殸 (a hanging stone chime being struck) plus 耳 (ear), an ear hearing a chime: sound. The simplified form keeps only the chime drawing at the top left.
纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 冬 (winter) as the sound: the end of a thread, hence end, finally. 冬 itself first drew a knotted cord end. Simplified from 終 by the short silk radical.

玩.def: to play with, to joke, to entertain

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 元 (first) as the sound: to play with, as with jade toys; then to have fun.

玩.name: play

origin.says: Simplified from 風: wind was first written with the phoenix bird, borrowed for its sound, with 凡 (all) added as the sound; the bird shrank to 虫 (bug). The simplified form replaces 虫 with a simple cross.

革.def: leather, animal hide; to reform; to remove

origin.says: A picture of an animal hide stretched flat, head at top and tail and legs below: leather. From changing a raw hide into leather it came to mean to reform or to remove.

革.name: leather

切.def: to cut, to mince, to slice, to carve; close to; eager

origin.says: 七 (seven, first a cross meaning cut) as the sound plus 刀 (knife) for the meaning: to cut, to slice.

切.name: cut

origin.says: Stands for 歲, 步 (steps) with 戉 (axe) as the sound: the passing of time, a year, years of age. The simplified form comes from an old popular variant, 山 (mountain) over 夕 (evening).

杀.def: to kill, to murder, to slaughter; to hurt

ety.hint: To kill 乂 someone and bury them in a coffin 木

origin.says: Simplified from 殺 (kill) by dropping 殳 (spear in hand) and a dot. The rest began as a boar struck in the head; its shape wore down to 乂 (cross) over 木 (tree).

杀.name: kill

害.def: to injure, to harm; to destroy, to kill

origin.says: The origin is disputed: one reading sees a lid over a container (the old form of 蓋 lid), borrowed for harm by sound; another sees a weapon with a mark, or a sound compound. The modern parts 宀 (roof), 丰 and 口 (mouth) are best taken by shape.

害.name: harm

协.def: to assist; to cooperate, to join; to harmonize

origin.says: Simplified from 協: 劦 (three 力, strength: many working together) with 十 (ten) added as a sound: to cooperate. Simplification replaced 劦 with 办 (to handle).

协.name: cooperate

origin.says: Simplified from 獨: 犭 (dog) for the meaning plus 蜀 (a caterpillar) as the sound; dogs fight and keep apart, alone. The simplified form keeps only 虫 (worm) from 蜀.

极.def: extreme, top; final, furthest, utmost; pole

origin.says: Traditional 極: 木 (wood) plus 亟 as the sound, the ridgepole, the highest beam of a house, hence utmost, extreme, pole. The simplification took over 极, an old rare character with 及 (reach) as its sound part.

极.name: ridgepole

ety.hint: A deer's head 自 adorned with antlers 丷

origin.says: A picture of a head, an eye with hair on top; the hair 巛 became the two dots. From head came chief, leader and first.

纪.def: discipline, age; period, era; record, annal

origin.says: Simplified from 紀: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 己 (self) as the sound: the end of a thread to bind with, hence order, discipline, records and eras.

纪.name: era

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 青 (blue-green) as the sound: water that is clear.

ety.hint: Two  parallel lines; compare 一 (one) and 三 (three)

origin.says: Two horizontal strokes, a tally for two.

往.def: to go, to depart; past, former

origin.says: First 止 (foot) plus 王 (king) as the sound, to go; 彳 (step) was added later. The foot and the sound part merged into a shape like 主 (master).

往.name: go toward

试.def: to try, to experiment; exam, test

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 式 (pattern) as the sound: to try, to test. Simplified from 試 with 言 (speech) in its short form.

试.name: try out

负.def: load, burden; to carry, to bear

ety.hint: A person 人 carrying a lot of money 贝

origin.says: A person ⺈ (person) on top of a cowry shell 貝 (money): a person carrying valuables on the back, a load to bear. Simplified by writing 貝 (shell) as 贝.

负.name: burden

步.def: walk, stroll, pace, march; to make progress

ety.hint: Modern form of 歨; putting one foot 止 in front of the other

origin.says: 止 (foot) over a reversed foot: one foot in front of the other, a step. Unrelated to 少 (few), which its bottom resembles.

步.name: step

ety.hint: A burning candle; the rays of the sun

origin.says: An old drawing whose subject is disputed: one reading sees an acorn, another a head or a thumbnail. It was used from early on for 'white'.

白.name: white
白.in: 的原源愿怕拍激迫邀皆皇伯貌谐泉凰柏棉泊煌锦缴舶绵藐皂魄帕碧腺惶啪揩皓皖楷蝗穆

origin.says: 不 (not) plus 口 (mouth): saying no, to deny. One source makes 不 (not) the sound and 口 (mouth) the meaning, the other the reverse; both fit 'no'.

列.def: a line; to arrange, to classify

origin.says: One reading: 歹 (bare bones) + 刂 (knife), cutting apart and laying out in a row. The seal form had another sound part in place of 歹, so it may be meaning+sound instead.

列.name: row

帮.def: to help, to assist; to support, to defend; party; gang

ety.hint: A nation's 邦 flag 巾; 邦 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Traditional 幫 is 帛 (silk) for the meaning plus 封 (seal) as the sound: first the upper of a shoe, then "to help". The simplified form uses 邦 (nation) for the sound and 巾 (cloth) for the meaning.

帮.name: assist

越.def: to exceed, to surpass, to transcend

origin.says: 走 (to run) for the meaning plus 戉 (a battle-axe) as the sound: to go over, to cross beyond, to exceed.

越.name: leap over

origin.says: 彳 (road, walking) plus 惪, itself 直 (straight) over 心 (heart), as the sound and meaning: walking through life with a straight heart, virtue. The 直 part has warped into 十 over 罒.

止.def: to stop, to halt; to detain; to desist

origin.says: A drawing of a foot (toes and sole). The foot that stands still gave the meaning 'stop'; the old sense 'foot' is now written 趾 (toe).

止.name: stop
止.in: 些此路跟企步频武肯跑址露距跳涉嘴踪践龄跨跃歧赋蹈跌踢扯耻跪蔬踩紫齿踏柴疏蹲濒徙躁趴啃鹉踊蹦蹋涩蹬雌蹄跤跋趾跛斌跷跺踱蹂蹭

叫.def: cry, shout; to call, to greet, to hail

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 丩 (entwined cords) as the sound: to shout, to call out.

叫.name: shout

策.def: to urge, to whip; method, plan, policy

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 朿 (thorn) as the sound: a bamboo whip or bamboo slips, hence 'to urge' and 'plan, policy'.

策.name: plan

装.def: dress, clothes, attire; to wear, to install

origin.says: Simplified from 裝: 衣 (clothes) for the meaning plus 壯 (sturdy) as the sound, now its simplified form 壮: to dress, then to pack and install.

装.name: outfit

origin.says: 交 (to cross) as the sound plus 攵 (hand striking, action): to imitate, to follow a model, hence effect, result.

击.def: to strike, to hit, to beat; to attack, to fight

ety.hint: Simplified form of 擊; 手 provides the meaning

origin.says: Simplified from 擊: 手 (hand) for the meaning plus 毄 (strike) as the sound, to strike. The simple form is a cursive outline that keeps only part of the shape.

击.name: strike

origin.says: Origin unclear: a base like 丙 (a stand), with a varying mark on top and 口 (mouth) added later. It named the Shang people and dynasty; 'trade' is said to come from Shang people becoming merchants.

闻.def: news; to hear, to smell; to make known

origin.says: 耳 (ear) for the meaning plus 门 (gate) as the sound: to hear, and from that news; also to smell. Simplified from 聞, with 門 written 门.

闻.name: hear news

项.def: neck, nape; item; a term in an equation

origin.says: 工 (work) as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: the back of the neck; then an item, a term. Simplified from 項, with 頁 (head) in short form.

项.name: nape

ety.hint: Simplified form of 馬, a horse galloping to the left

origin.says: Old forms draw a standing horse: big eye and head, flowing mane, legs and tail (the four dots of 馬). The simplified 马 comes from cursive writing of 馬.

马.name: horse
马.in: 吗验妈骗码驻骑骂驶驾骄驱玛骚骤腾驳闯驰驴蚂骡冯骇驯驮驹驼骆骏

复.def: again, repeatedly; copy, duplicate; to restore, to return

ety.hint: A person 亻 who goes  somewhere 夂 every day 日

origin.says: A building or passage on top and 夂 (a downward foot) below: going back home, return, again. Simplification also folded 復 (return), 複 (double) and 覆 (overturn) into it. Readings of the top differ.

复.name: return again

origin.says: Simplified from 頻, first written 瀕: a person 頁 (head) whose feet 步 (step) reach the water's edge, on the verge. The water was dropped for the sense frequent; 頁 became 页. Origin partly unclear.
Simplified from 優: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 憂 (worry) as the sound. The simplified form uses the simpler 尤 (especially) as the sound: excellent, superior.

致.def: to send; to present, to deliver; to cause; consequence

origin.says: 至 (arrive) as the sound plus 攵 (hand with stick, action) for the meaning: to make something arrive, to send or bring about. It also took over 緻 (fine, delicate).

致.name: deliver

origin.says: From 黨: 尚 (esteem) as the sound plus 黑 (black) for the meaning; it came to mean a group of families, a faction, a party. Simplified by replacing 黑 with 儿 (legs).
攵 (hand with a stick, marking action) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound. From 'what was before': old, former, and the cause of something, the reason.

随.def: to follow, to listen to, to submit to

ety.hint: To walk 迶 to the city 阝; to follow a path

origin.says: Simplified from 隨: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 隋 as the sound; the simplified form writes the sound part 隋 as 陏 (阝 + 有 (have)). Walking after someone: to follow.

随.name: tag along

读.def: to study, to learn; to read, to pronounce

ety.hint: To show off 卖 one's literacy 讠

origin.says: Simplified from 讀: 言 (speech, now 讠) for the meaning plus a sound part that looks like 賣 (sell), now 卖: to say aloud, to recite, to read.

读.name: read aloud

赛.def: to compete, to contend; contest, race

origin.says: Simplified from 賽: a shortened 塞 (to block) as the sound plus 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning: first offerings in thanks, then a contest for a prize. 貝 became 贝.

赛.name: contest

待.def: to entertain, to receive, to treat; to delay, to wait

ety.hint: To welcome someone arriving 彳 at the royal court 寺

origin.says: 彳 (step, road) for the meaning plus 寺 (temple) as the sound: to wait for someone on the road, to receive and treat them.

待.name: treat guest

警.def: to guard, to watch; alarm, alert

origin.says: 敬 (revere) as the sound plus 言 (speech) for the meaning: words that warn, to be on guard; now also police.

警.name: alert

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 束 (bundle) as the sound: to move fast, speedy.
Simplified from 職: 耳 (ear) for the meaning plus 戠 as the sound: what one hears and keeps in mind, a duty, an office. 戠 was replaced by 只 (only).

ety.hint: Simplified form of 戶; a door swinging on its hinge

origin.says: Draws a single-leaf door on a post, half of the double door 門 (gate). From door it came to mean household. The simplified form only straightens the top stroke of 戶.

户.name: door
户.in: 护房编骗遍启篇偏雇肩煽扇妒炉扁驴翩芦庐沪匾肇蝙

origin.says: Earliest forms are a single upright line for one set of ten; later a dot or knot in the middle grew into the cross stroke. One view sees a knot in a counting cord, another a needle borrowed for its sound.

十.name: ten
十.in: 什真计做据技续支喜质协德故读早居韩镇克古剧章毕华卖率博针载障草苦索估固裁鼓掉朝湖循姑截戴盾胡翰潮愤歧碎填糊奔醉辜慎喷粹膨

诉.def: to accuse, to sue; to inform; to narrate

ety.hint: Words 讠 of blame 斥; 斥 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 斥 (to blame) as the sound: to accuse in words, to tell. Simplified from 訴.

诉.name: accuse

ety.hint: A person 儿 carrying a torch 火

origin.says: Fire (火) above a kneeling person: a person holding up a flame, light. The fire has become ⺌ and its last stroke joined the person below, which now reads as 兀, so the split is by shape.

绝.def: to cut, to sever; to break off, to terminate

origin.says: Originally a knife (刀) cutting through silk threads: to cut off. The right side later grew into a shape like 色 (color), which is unrelated; simplified from 絕 with 纟 (silk) in its short form.

绝.name: cut off

张.def: to display; to expand, to open; to stretch; a sheet of paper

origin.says: Simplified from 張: 弓 (bow) for the meaning plus 长 (long) as the sound. It first meant to string or draw a bow, hence 'stretch, open out'; also a counter for flat sheets.

张.name: drawn bow

施.def: to grant, to bestow; to act; surname

origin.says: 㫃 (waving flag, 方 + 𠂉) for the meaning plus 也 (also) as the sound: first a flag unfurling, then to spread out, to grant, to carry out.

施.name: bestow
